page_title: Cykel - Digital Workers for Recruitment, Sales & Research Teams

summary.name: Cykel
summary.one_liner: Cykel is a digital worker platform offering AI agents for recruitment (Lucy), sales development (Eve), and business research (Samson).
use_cases: automate candidate sourcing and CV screening
generate company research and analyst reports
summary.what_it_does: Cykel provides a platform to run and manage specialized AI "digital workers" that handle business tasks autonomously. Lucy is an AI recruiter that automates sourcing, screening and admin tasks; Eve is an AI SDR that automates prospecting, outreach and follow-ups; Samson is an AI business analyst that researches and writes company reports. The page says workers integrate with existing tools such as an ATS or CRM and can be given permissions, workflows and real-time monitoring. Every action is said to be logged and audited.
notable: Three named digital workers: Lucy (recruiting), Eve (sales), Samson (business research)
Audit logging of every digital worker action
Claimed setup within 24 hours with no complex setup needed
Data stated as not used to train models
caveats: Pricing is not published; the page says to contact sales for a personalized quote
Samson is listed with a 'Request Access' button, suggesting limited availability
Claims such as 5-10x output and $1.63 daily rate are vendor marketing figures
